name: Ivindo National Park
description: Ivindo National Park covers nearly 300,000 hectares of rainforest on the equator in northern Gabon. Dark, tea-coloured rivers wind through the forest and tumble over rapids and waterfalls, the best known being Kongou and Mingouli. Forest elephants, gorillas, chimpanzees and mandrills live among the trees, while the rivers hold many fish species that are still unnamed by science.
